text: Whereis Shipment Tracking for DeepSeek Harness 是一个 DSH 插件包，适用于配置了 MCP 的 DSH 客户端：它通过配置将 DSH MCP 客户端连接到 Whereis 托管服务。README 列出的能力包括查询可用承运商、查看包裹最新状态，以及在配置可选密钥后获取完整追踪历史。用户可用承运商代码和追踪号询问物流进度，适合需要在 DSH 会话中查询快递状态的场景。运行需要可访问 api.eg1.io；完整历史需自行配置 WHEREIS_API_KEY。仓库只提供连接配置，远端服务实现查询工具。

Whereis Shipment Tracking for DeepSeek Harness connects DSH to the Whereis MCP service. It supports carrier lookup and latest shipment status, with full history when WHEREIS_API_KEY is configured. The bundle provides connection settings; the remote service implements the tools.
想在 DSH 里查一个包裹现在到哪里了。
DSH 能帮我查这个快递单号的最新物流状态吗？
让 DSH 查询支持哪些快递承运商。
Can I ask DSH to check the latest status of a parcel?
I want to look up which carrier codes are supported from my DSH session.
有需要密钥才能看的完整物流轨迹时，能不能通过 DSH 查到？
Whereis Shipment Tracking for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「连接 Whereis MCP」：配置 DSH MCP 客户端连接托管服务，供会话调用物流查询工具。
Whereis Shipment Tracking for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「查看最新状态」：用户在 DSH 中提供承运商和追踪号后，可查询包裹当前状态、地点和最近一次扫描记录。
Whereis Shipment Tracking for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「查询承运商代码」：用户可询问可用承运商，并将 fdx、sfex 或 eg1 等代码用于后续包裹查询。
Whereis Shipment Tracking for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「查看完整追踪历史」：配置可选 API key 后，可按追踪号获取完整事件时间线和投递凭证；无密钥时此能力不可用。
帮我确认这票货最近一次扫描的地点和时间。
Look up the delivery history for a tracking number when I provide a key.

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · Whereis Shipment Tracking for DeepSeek Harness：A configuration-only DSH bundle that connects the Eagle1 Whereis MCP server.
Once installed, the agent can list carriers, read the latest shipment status,
and — with an API key — retrieve full tracking history.

text:
eagle1-whereis-mcp README · What you get：| Tool | What it does | API key |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp__whereis__list_operators` | Resolve `fdx` / `sfex` / `eg1` carrier codes | No |
| `mcp__whereis__get_latest_status` | Current status, location, and last scan | No |
| `mcp__whereis__track_shipment` | Full event timeline and delivery proof | Yes |

Plus the `whereis://reference/status-codes` resource.

The bundle points at the hosted endpoint:

```text
https://api.eg1.io/mcp
```

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · What you get：No API key is needed for the connection itself. Anonymous users get
`list_operators` and `get_latest_status`; a key unlocks `track_shipment`.

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.5`
- A reachable Whereis MCP endpoint at `https://api.eg1.io/mcp`
- An API key only if you want full history

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · From GitHub (available now)：```text
plugin_manager
  action: install_bundle
  target: git+https://github.com/eagle1-sys/eagle1-whereis-mcp.git#v1.0.2
```

Pin the tag for a stable version, or replace `v1.0.2` with a full commit SHA
for an immutable install. If you previously installed a local
`@local/whereis-mcp`, remove it first so the `whereis-mcp` row is not duplicated.

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · From the DSH Plugins page (npm, after publishing)：Open **Plugins**, choose **Install**, and enter:

```text
eagle1-whereis-mcp
```

or a pinned version:

```text
eagle1-whereis-mcp@1.0.2
```

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · No key vs. key：| Capability | No key | With key |
|---|---|---|
| `list_operators` | Yes | Yes |
| `get_latest_status` | Yes | Yes |
| `track_shipment` | No | Yes |
| `refresh=true` carrier pull | No | Yes |

If anonymous MCP connections are not enabled on the deployment, no-key users
can still call the public status endpoint directly:

```bash
curl "https://api.eg1.io/v0/status/fdx-879448793247"
```

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · Add a key (optional)：To unlock full history, add a higher-priority override to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` (or the equivalent profile patch) that restates the whole
row:

```yaml
- id: whereis-mcp
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: whereis

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · Add a key (optional)：Set `WHEREIS_API_KEY` in the environment that launches DeepSeek Harness. The
`!!js` expression is evaluated in the Harness process, not in the conversation,
so the key does not appear in chat. If your client cannot use `!!js`, put a
local-only literal in the profile patch instead and keep that file out of
version control.

Do not put keys in this package, in `cordis.patch.yml` inside the bundle, or in
a message.

What carriers does Whereis support?

Where is fdx-879448793247?

For SF Express, include the last four digits of the recipient's phone. Tracking
IDs are `<operator>-<tracking_number>`.

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Tools do not appear | Check that the bundle is installed and selected; check the MCP connection error in Plugins |
| `401-01` / `401-02` | No key or a bad key. Status-only works without one; add a key only for history |
| `403-01` | The key is restricted; use a full key |
| `404-01` | The carrier has no data; verify the number or note retention limits |
| Connection fails at startup | Confirm `https://api.eg1.io/mcp` is live and reachable |
| HTTP 403 from a self-hosted endpoint | Check `MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` / connect from an allowed host |

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · Privacy：The agent sends only tracking IDs and, for SF Express, the last four phone
digits to the API. It should not send names, addresses, or other personal data.
The package contains no credentials and no tracking data.

eagle1-whereis-mcp README · Uninstall：Remove `eagle1-whereis-mcp` from the Plugins page, or:

```text
plugin_manager
  action: remove_bundle
  target: eagle1-whereis-mcp
```
